purpose: Report an established rule, arrangement, or schedule.
keywords: Verb dictionary form / negative form + ことになっている
Eating and drinking are not allowed in the library.
A new person is scheduled to take over next week.
The arrangement is to return the key to the caretaker.
formation: Verb dictionary form / negative form + ことになっている
restrictions: Presents an existing arrangement rather than a fresh personal decision.
mistake: Use ことにしている for a personal practice you maintain.
